description: Itinéraires Vélo et Pédestre is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. ![picto public dictionary Dictionary Public]( l) This dataset represents in linear form the tourist walking and cycling routes on Bordeaux Métropole. It contains major national or European routes as well as local loops. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle and Pedestrian Routes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bordeaux Métropole. Its keywords include data-gouv, cyclables, velo, voirie, voies, pistes. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
